title: The Loudest Sound in Recorded History
description: Krakatoa, 1883: an eruption heard across the Indian Ocean.

scenes.narration: This was the loudest sound in recorded history. People heard it nearly five thousand kilometres away.
scenes.image_prompt: colossal volcanic explosion on a tropical island, shockwave rippling across the sea, 1883

scenes.narration: It's August 27th, 1883. The volcanic island of Krakatoa, between Java and Sumatra.
scenes.image_prompt: Krakatoa volcano island smoking in a tropical strait, sailing ships nearby, 19th century

scenes.narration: After months of rumbling, a series of colossal eruptions tears the island apart.
scenes.image_prompt: enormous ash column and lightning above Krakatoa, sea boiling, darkness at midday

scenes.narration: On the island of Rodrigues, far across the Indian Ocean, people think it's distant cannon fire.
scenes.image_prompt: 19th century islanders on a beach turning toward the horizon in alarm, calm sea

scenes.narration: The pressure wave circles the Earth several times. Barometers around the world record it.
scenes.image_prompt: Victorian scientist looking at a barometer needle jumping in a wood-panelled observatory

scenes.narration: Tsunamis over thirty metres high strike the nearby coasts.
scenes.image_prompt: giant tsunami wave approaching a coastal village with palm trees and stilt houses, 1883

scenes.narration: More than thirty-six thousand people die.
scenes.image_prompt: ruined coastal village after a tsunami, grey ash-covered landscape, survivors in distance

scenes.narration: Ash in the sky turned sunsets blood red around the world for months. Which disaster should we cover next?
scenes.image_prompt: blood red dramatic sunset over a European city with church towers, 1883
